name: vela
description: Vela: autonomous AI engineering control plane (Windows-first desktop application)

scripts.fmt: npm run fmt:ts && npm run fmt:rust
scripts.fmt:check: npm run fmt:check:ts && npm run fmt:check:rust
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:rust
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:ts: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:scripts
scripts.verify:ts: npm run fmt:check:ts && npm run lint:ts && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ts
scripts.verify:rust: npm run fmt:check:rust && npm run check:structure && npm run lint:rust && npm run build:rust && npm run test:rust
scripts.verify: npm run verify:ts && npm run verify:rust
